description:
Landstalker: The Treasures of King Nole is a classic Action-RPG with an isometric view (also known as "2.5D").
You play Nigel, a treasure hunter exploring the island of Mercator trying to find the legendary treasure.
Roam freely on the island, get stronger to beat dungeons and gather the required key items in order to reach the
hidden palace and claim the treasure.
game: Landstalker - The Treasures of King Nole

1.1.description:
This version adds lots of useful features compared to 1.0:
- added an automatic item tracker
- added an automatic map tracker
- improved UI to make it easier & more efficient to use

This also brings a bunch of small bugfixes and enhancements here and there.

Enjoy and feel free to report any bug / issue you would find when using it.

(The APWorld file is the server-side world package for Archipelago, only download it if you need to generate and host games on your own)
1.1.title: Randstalker Archipelago Client 1.1

1.3.0.description:
# Client changes

- **Added Bizhawk support**
- Added error forwarding from the rando to the client to have clear error messages when ROM fails to build
- Fixed item tracker hinting the wrong item names on armors when progressive armors was enabled 
- Moved a potentially blocking Foxy at Ryuma's lighthouse
- Fixed map tracker being broken in seeds with "Shuffle trees" enabled
- Fixed a few UI quirks
- Fixed some errors with the map tracker logic
- Optimized AP network usage

# Server changes

- Added support for more jewels for more intricate seeds (max is now 9 instead of 5)
- Fixed very rare cases of unbeatable seeds
- Improved hints generation a bit
- Lots of small optimizations
1.3.0.title: Randstalker Archipelago 1.3.0
